generalTab.comment: Settings sidebar row + pane title: the general settings pane.

romanizationSystem.comment: Picker label for which romanization is typed. The macOS picker offers TL and POJ only.

candidateSection.comment: Settings section header over the candidate-behaviour toggles.

translateSwapped.comment: Settings toggle: commit the romanization instead of the Hanji.

values.ja: 漢字とローマ字を入れ替え

learningSection.comment: Settings section header over the two learning toggles.

shortcutsTab.comment: Sidebar label for the settings pane holding the shortcut and key bindings.

shortcutOpenSettings.comment: Shortcut-recorder row: the hotkey that opens this settings window.

shortcutToggleRomanization.comment: Shortcut-recorder row: the hotkey that switches between the two romanizations. Each row is authored whole rather than composed from the setting's own label, whose wording is a verb phrase in several languages.

values.ja: ローマ字体系を切り替える

shortcutToggleTranslateSwapped.comment: Shortcut-recorder row: the hotkey that flips which script is committed.

values.ja: 漢字とローマ字の入れ替えを切り替える

shortcutToggleBothScripts.comment: Shortcut-recorder row: the hotkey that turns bracket annotation on and off. Names the setting by the shared label its settings row uses.

values.ja: 括弧での併記を切り替える

shortcutToggleLiteralRomanCandidate.comment: Shortcut-recorder row: the hotkey that shows or hides the typed-romanization candidate. Names the setting by the shared label its settings row uses.

values.hanji: 切換 顯示原本羅馬字候選
values.ja: 入力したローマ字候補の表示を切り替える

menuSettings.comment: Input-source menu command that opens the settings window. The trailing ellipsis is HIG-required for a command that opens a window, and is authored per language rather than appended at the call site.

menuFile.comment: Menu-bar File menu title. An LSUIElement process builds its own menu bar so the settings window keeps the standard editing shortcuts.

menuClose.comment: File menu item: close the front window (⌘W).

dictionarySearchSection.comment: Settings sidebar row + pane title: the dictionary-search page.

dictionarySourcesLink.comment: Settings sidebar row + pane title: the dictionary-source toggles page. iOS lists the toggles inline instead.

allSourcesOffFooter.comment: Footer under the supplementary-source toggles: what turning every dictionary off does.

values.hanji: 關掉全部辭典,拍字就袂有詞庫候選。
values.tailo: kuainn-tiāu tsuân-pōo sû-tián, phah-jī tō bē ū sû-khòo hāu-suán.
values.poj: koaiⁿ-tiāu choân-pō͘ sû-tián, phah-jī tō bē ū sû-khò͘ hāu-soán.
values.en: With every dictionary off, typing produces no dictionary candidates.
values.ja: すべての辞書をオフにすると、入力しても辞書候補は出ません。

openURLFailed.comment: Alert title when NSWorkspace could not open a dictionary's web page. macOS-only: the iOS opener is fire-and-forget.

values.ja: ページを開けませんでした

customDictReadFailed.comment: Alert title when the custom-dictionary store could not be read.

values.en: Could Not Read the Custom Dictionary
values.ja: カスタム辞書を読み込めませんでした

customDictWriteFailed.comment: Alert title when a custom-dictionary write failed.

values.en: Could Not Save to the Custom Dictionary
values.ja: カスタム辞書に保存できませんでした

frequencyReadFailed.comment: Alert title when the word-frequency store could not be read.

values.en: Could Not Read the Frequency Records
values.ja: 単語頻度を読み込めませんでした

frequencyWriteFailed.comment: Alert title when a word-frequency write failed.

values.en: Could Not Save the Frequency Records
values.ja: 単語頻度を保存できませんでした

associationReadFailed.comment: Alert title when the word-association store could not be read.

values.en: Could Not Read the Association Records
values.ja: 単語連携を読み込めませんでした

associationWriteFailed.comment: Alert title when a word-association write failed.

values.en: Could Not Save the Association Records
values.ja: 単語連携を保存できませんでした

progressSaving.comment: Label under the spinner while a 詞庫 page saves. macOS-only: the mobile apps have no blocking overlay.

progressDeleting.comment: Label under the spinner while a 詞庫 page deletes.

progressExporting.comment: Label under the spinner while a 詞庫 page writes a CSV.

progressImporting.comment: Label under the spinner while a 詞庫 page reads a CSV.

progressBackingUp.comment: Label under the spinner while the backup file is written.

progressRestoring.comment: Label under the spinner while a backup file is restored.

importComplete.comment: Alert title after a CSV import finished. iOS titles the alert with the action's own name instead.

values.ja: 読み込みが完了しました

notUTF8Detail.comment: Alert body when an imported file is not UTF-8 — a different cause from a malformed CSV, which has its own message.

values.hanji: 這个檔案毋是 UTF-8 文字。
values.tailo: tsit ê tóng-àn m̄-sī UTF-8 bûn-jī.
values.poj: chit ê tóng-àn m̄-sī UTF-8 bûn-jī.
values.en: This file is not UTF-8 text.
values.ja: このファイルは UTF-8 テキストではありません。

irreversible.comment: Body of every 詞庫 clear-everything confirmation; the question itself is the dialog's title.

values.ja: この操作は取り消せません。

userDataPrivacyFooter.comment: One footer under the CSV actions on all three 詞庫 list pages. The mobile apps carry a different warning per page.

values.hanji: 這份資料干焦囥佇你的電腦,袂上傳。匯出的檔案內底有你拍過的字,請家己保管好。
values.tailo: tsit hūn tsu-liāu kan-na khǹg tī lí ê tiān-náu, bē siōng-thuân. huē-tshut ê tóng-àn lāi-té ū lí phah--kuè ê jī, tshiánn ka-kī pó-kuán hó.
values.poj: chit hūn chu-liāu kan-na khǹg tī lí ê tiān-náu, bē siōng-thoân. hōe-chhut ê tóng-àn lāi-té ū lí phah--kòe ê jī, chhiáⁿ ka-kī pó-koán hó.
values.en: This data stays on your Mac and is never uploaded. An exported file contains words you have typed, so keep it safe.
values.ja: このデータはこの Mac にのみ保存され、アップロードされません。書き出したファイルには入力した単語が含まれるため、大切に保管してください。

customDictEmpty.comment: Empty state on the custom-dictionary page. Not the shared key, whose copy names a `+` affordance macOS does not have.

values.ja: まだカスタム単語がありません。

entriesSection.comment: Section header over the custom-dictionary rows. The shared key is already the page title one line above.

forgetWord.comment: Row action on the frequency page. Deliberately not the shared delete label: it undoes what the keyboard learned rather than removing a record the user wrote.

learnedWordsSection.comment: Section header over the frequency rows. The shared key is already the page title one line above.

forgetPair.comment: Row action on the association page. See macos.forgetWord for why this is not the shared delete label.

learnedPairsSection.comment: Section header over the association rows. The shared key is already the page title one line above.

associationNotUsedFooter.comment: Footer under the association-recording toggle. Not the shared explainer, which promises next-word suggestions macOS does not make yet.

values.hanji: 台語鍵盤佇 macOS 猶未用關聯來推薦後一个詞,毋過學著的資料會先留咧。
values.tailo: Tâi-gí kiān-puânn tī macOS iáu-buē iōng kuan-liân lâi tshui-tsiàn āu tsi̍t ê sû, m̄-koh ha̍k-tio̍h ê tsu-liāu ē sing lâu--leh.
values.poj: Tâi-gí kiān-pôaⁿ tī macOS iáu-bōe iōng koan-liân lâi chhui-chiàn āu chi̍t ê sû, m̄-koh ha̍k-tio̍h ê chu-liāu ē seng lâu--leh.
values.en: TaigiKeyboard does not use associations to suggest the next word on macOS yet, but what it has learned is kept.
values.ja: macOS では単語連携を次の単語の提案にまだ使っていませんが、学習した記録は保持されます。

backupFileSection.comment: Section header over the backup export/import buttons.

values.ja: バックアップファイル

backupFooter.comment: Footer under the backup buttons. Not the shared warning, which describes iOS/Android interop rather than this Mac's Time Machine coverage.

values.hanji: 備份內底有自訂詞庫、詞頻佮詞關聯,攏是你拍字的紀錄,請家己保管好。這台電腦的資料會綴 Time Machine 做備份;欲徙去別台電腦,愛用這个檔案。
values.tailo: pī-hūn lāi-té ū tsū-tīng-sû-khòo, sû pîn kah sû kuan-liân, lóng sī lí phah-jī ê kì-lio̍k, tshiánn ka-kī pó-kuán hó. tsit tâi tiān-náu ê tsu-liāu ē tuè Time Machine tsò pī-hūn; beh suá khì pa̍t tâi tiān-náu, ài iōng tsit ê tóng-àn.
values.poj: pī-hūn lāi-té ū chū-tēng-sû-khò͘, sû pîn kah sû koan-liân, lóng sī lí phah-jī ê kì-lio̍k, chhiáⁿ ka-kī pó-koán hó. chit tâi tiān-náu ê chu-liāu ē tòe Time Machine chò pī-hūn; beh sóa khì pa̍t tâi tiān-náu, ài iōng chit ê tóng-àn.
values.en: A backup holds your custom dictionary, frequency records, and association records — everything the keyboard learned from your typing. Keep the file safe. This Mac's data is covered by Time Machine; moving it to another Mac needs this file.
values.ja: バックアップには、カスタム辞書・単語頻度・単語連携という、入力から学習した記録が含まれます。ファイルは大切に保管してください。この Mac のデータは Time Machine でバックアップされます。別の Mac へ移すにはこのファイルが必要です。

importRulesSection.comment: Section header over the explanation of how a restore merges.

importRulesBody.comment: How a restore merges into what is already stored.

values.hanji: 匯入的時,已經有的資料袂消失:自訂詞庫加新的,詞頻佮詞關聯取較大的次數。
values.tailo: huē-ji̍p ê sî, í-king ū ê tsu-liāu bē siau-sit: tsū-tīng-sû-khòo ke sin ê, sû pîn kah sû kuan-liân tshú khah tuā ê tshù-sòo.
values.poj: hōe-ji̍p ê sî, í-keng ū ê chu-liāu bē siau-sit: chū-tēng-sû-khò͘ ke sin ê, sû pîn kah sû koan-liân chhú khah tōa ê chhù-sò͘.
values.en: Importing keeps what is already there: custom words are added, and frequency and association records keep whichever count is higher.
values.ja: 読み込みでは既存のデータは失われません。カスタム単語は追加され、単語頻度と単語連携は大きい方の回数が残ります。

backupFailed.comment: Alert title when writing the backup file failed. Distinct from the shared export-failure title, which the three CSV pages use.

values.ja: バックアップに失敗しました

restoreFailed.comment: Alert title when the backup file could not be read at all.

restoreComplete.comment: Alert title when every category of a backup restored.

restorePartial.comment: Alert title when a backup restored some categories and not others. The three databases cannot be restored in one transaction.

values.ja: 一部のみ復元しました

restoreLineCustomDictionary.comment: One line of the restore report. Authored whole per category and outcome rather than composed from a verb, which does not inflect across languages.

values.ja: カスタム辞書：{count} 件を追加

restoreLineFrequency.comment: One line of the restore report. 處理 rather than 新增: the merge keeps whichever count is higher, so a row that changed nothing was still read and considered.

values.ja: 単語頻度：{count} 件を処理

restoreLineAssociation.comment: One line of the restore report. See macos.restoreLineFrequency for why this says 處理.

values.ja: 単語連携：{count} 件を処理

restoreLineCustomDictionaryFailed.comment: One line of the restore report when this category failed. The store's own reason is untranslated, so each language punctuates around it.

restoreLineFrequencyFailed.comment: One line of the restore report when this category failed.

restoreLineAssociationFailed.comment: One line of the restore report when this category failed.

candidateWindowLayout.comment: Picker label in the 一般 pane: which shape the candidate window takes (horizontal row / vertical list / expandable grid).

values.ja: 候補ウィンドウの配置

candidateLayoutHorizontal.comment: Picker value: the horizontal single-row candidate window, paged left to right.

candidateLayoutVertical.comment: Picker value: the vertical scrolling-list candidate window.

candidateLayoutExpandable.comment: Picker value: the expandable candidate window — one row that unfolds into a grid via its chevron.

candidateWindowAppearance.comment: Picker label in the 一般 pane: which chrome generation the candidate window draws. Values: the shared Automatic key, plus Sequoia / Tahoe below.

values.ja: 候補ウィンドウの外観

candidateStyleSequoia.comment: Picker value: the macOS 15 Sequoia look (vibrancy). Proper noun — identical in every language.

candidateStyleTahoe.comment: Picker value: the macOS 26 Tahoe look (glass). Proper noun — identical in every language.

appearanceTab.comment: Settings sidebar row + pane title: the candidate-window appearance pane (layout, chrome, accent colour).

candidateAccentColor.comment: Label above the accent-colour swatch row in the 外觀 pane. The candidate window's highlight colour.

candidateAccentBlue.comment: Accessibility label + tooltip for one accent swatch circle in the 外觀 pane. Colour name matches the macOS accent of the same hue.

candidateAccentPurple.comment: Accessibility label + tooltip for one accent swatch circle in the 外觀 pane. Colour name matches the macOS accent of the same hue.

candidateAccentPink.comment: Accessibility label + tooltip for one accent swatch circle in the 外觀 pane. Colour name matches the macOS accent of the same hue.

candidateAccentRed.comment: Accessibility label + tooltip for one accent swatch circle in the 外觀 pane. Colour name matches the macOS accent of the same hue.

candidateAccentOrange.comment: Accessibility label + tooltip for one accent swatch circle in the 外觀 pane. Colour name matches the macOS accent of the same hue.

candidateAccentYellow.comment: Accessibility label + tooltip for one accent swatch circle in the 外觀 pane. Colour name matches the macOS accent of the same hue.

candidateAccentGreen.comment: Accessibility label + tooltip for one accent swatch circle in the 外觀 pane. Colour name matches the macOS accent of the same hue.

candidateAccentGraphite.comment: Accessibility label + tooltip for one accent swatch circle in the 外觀 pane. Colour name matches the macOS accent of the same hue.

candidateAppearanceLight.comment: Caption under the light-mode thumbnail in the 外觀 pane's appearance selector, mirroring System Settings' Appearance row.

candidateAppearanceDark.comment: Caption under the dark-mode thumbnail in the 外觀 pane's appearance selector, mirroring System Settings' Appearance row.

candidateWindowSize.comment: Picker label: how much air the candidate window puts around its text.

values.ja: 候補ウィンドウの大きさ

sizeSmall.comment: Picker value shared by the candidate window-size and text-size rows: the smallest step.

sizeMedium.comment: Picker value shared by the candidate window-size and text-size rows: the default step.

sizeLarge.comment: Picker value shared by the candidate window-size and text-size rows: the larger step.

sizeExtraLarge.comment: Picker value for the candidate text-size row: the largest step.

shortcutsGlobalSection.comment: Settings section header over the freely recorded global shortcut chords.

values.ja: グローバルショートカット

shortcutsComposingSection.comment: Settings section header over the pickers that bind keys used while composing.

shortcutsFixedKeysNote.comment: Footer under the composing-key pickers, listing the keys that are never bindable.

values.hanji: 方向鍵揀候選字,Page Up／Page Down 翻頁,Esc 取消,Delete 刪字 —— 這幾个袂當改。
values.tailo: Hong-hiòng kiān kíng hāu-suán-jī, Page Up／Page Down huan-ia̍h, Esc tshú-siau, Delete thâi-jī — tsit kuí ê bē-tàng kái.
values.poj: Hong-hiòng kiān kéng hāu-soán-jī, Page Up／Page Down hoan-ia̍h, Esc chhú-siau, Delete thâi-jī — chit kúi ê bē-tàng kái.
values.en: Arrow keys move through candidates, Page Up/Page Down turn pages, Esc cancels, and Delete removes a character. These cannot be changed.
values.ja: 矢印キーで候補を移動、Page Up／Page Down でページを送り、Esc で取り消し、Delete で 1 文字削除します。これらは変更できません。

bindingReturnKey.comment: Picker label: what the Return key does while composing.

bindingSpaceKey.comment: Picker label: what the space bar does while the candidate window is up.

bindingBracketPaging.comment: Picker label: what the [ and ] keys do while the candidate window is up.

bindingTabCycle.comment: Picker label: what Tab and Shift-Tab do while the candidate window is up.

bindingSlotModifier.comment: Picker label: which modifier is chorded with 1-9 to pick a candidate by position.

bindingCommitLiteral.comment: Picker option: send the romanization exactly as typed, not the highlighted candidate.

bindingConfirmHighlighted.comment: Picker option: send the candidate the window has highlighted.

bindingNextCandidate.comment: Picker option: move the highlight to the next candidate instead of committing.

bindingTurnPage.comment: Picker option: page the candidate window backward and forward.

bindingTypeTheCharacter.comment: Picker option: the key types its own character instead of driving the candidate window.

bindingWalkCandidates.comment: Picker option: Tab moves to the next candidate, Shift-Tab to the previous one.

values.hanji: 揀候選字（Tab 下一个、⇧Tab 頂一个）
values.tailo: kíng hāu-suán-jī（Tab ē-tsi̍t ê、⇧Tab tíng-tsi̍t ê）
values.poj: kéng hāu-soán-jī（Tab ē-chi̍t ê、⇧Tab téng-chi̍t ê）
values.ja: 候補を移動（Tab で次、⇧Tab で前）

bindingLeaveToApp.comment: Picker option: the key is left to the app, which is what it does today.

bindingReturnFooter.comment: Footer under the Return picker: explains the Shift-Return escape hatch.

values.hanji: 揀「送出選著的候選字」的時,⇧Return 猶原送出原本拍的字。
values.tailo: Kíng “sàng-tshut suán-tio̍h ê hāu-suán-jī” ê sî, ⇧Return iu-guân sàng-tshut guân-pún phah ê jī.
values.poj: Kéng “sàng-chhut soán-tio̍h ê hāu-soán-jī” ê sî, ⇧Return iû-goân sàng-chhut goân-pún phah ê jī.
values.en: When Return sends the highlighted candidate, ⇧Return still sends what you typed.
values.ja: Return が候補を確定する設定でも、⇧Return は入力したままを確定します。

bindingSpaceFooter.comment: Footer under the space picker: names the keys left to commit with when space walks the list.

values.hanji: 揀「換下一个候選字」的時,用選字鍵送出;Return 若設做送出選著的候選字,嘛會使用 Return。
values.tailo: Kíng “uānn ē-tsi̍t ê hāu-suán-jī” ê sî, iōng suán-jī kiān sàng-tshut; Return nā siat-tsò sàng-tshut suán-tio̍h ê hāu-suán-jī, mā ē-sái iōng Return.
values.poj: Kéng “oāⁿ ē-chi̍t ê hāu-soán-jī” ê sî, ēng soán-jī kiān sàng-chhut; Return nā siat-chò sàng-chhut soán-tio̍h ê hāu-soán-jī, mā ē-sái ēng Return.
values.en: When the space bar moves through candidates, commit with the candidate number keys — or with Return, if you set Return to send the highlighted candidate.
values.ja: スペースキーで候補を移動する設定では、候補選択キーで確定します。Return を「選択中の候補を確定」にしていれば Return でも確定できます。
